ch_first_smile.text: Your face does something new. Everyone in the room agrees it was a smile and not gas.

ch_sleepless_night.text: It is 3 a.m. and you have decided the whole house should be awake. You are very committed to this.

outcomes.rescued: Someone carries you around the kitchen until dawn. You win.
outcomes.ignored: The grown-ups take turns pretending to sleep. You finally pass out from sheer effort.

ch_first_word.text: You open your mouth and a real word comes out. Everyone leans in, phones raised.

ch_first_steps.text: You let go of the couch. The floor looks very far away and very hard.

outcomes.wobble: You make it four whole steps before sitting down hard. Applause erupts.
outcomes.faceplant: Gravity wins. You cry for ten seconds, then try again.

ch_baby_food_war.text: A spoon of mashed peas approaches your face like a tiny green airplane. You have opinions.

outcomes.laugh: The spoon-holder laughs so hard they forget the rest of the peas.
outcomes.scolded: You are wearing the peas now. Nobody is laughing.

ch_tantrum.text: The grocery store will not buy you the cereal with the cartoon tiger. You make your feelings known to the entire aisle.

outcomes.cereal: The cereal is yours. You learn a dangerous lesson about leverage.
outcomes.nope: You get carried out like a sack of potatoes. No cereal.

ch_imaginary_friend.text: You have a new friend named Sir Biscuit. Only you can see him, and he has a lot of demands.

choices.tea: Set a place at the table

ch_wall_masterpiece.text: You find a box of crayons and an enormous blank wall. The wall is practically asking for it.

outcomes.gallery: Your parents stare, then laugh, then frame a section. You are an artist now.
outcomes.grounded: The wall has been repainted. You have been sent to your room to think about art.

ch_goldfish.text: You win a goldfish at the fair, in a plastic bag. Its name is yours to choose and its future is uncertain.

choices.keep: Take it home, name it Gerald

ch_goldfish_funeral.text: Gerald is floating in an unfortunate direction. The fishbowl suddenly feels very quiet.

choices.replace: Quietly swap in a new fish

outcomes.unnoticed: Nobody notices. Gerald 2.0 settles in beautifully.
outcomes.noticed: Your parent notices immediately and gives the speech about honesty.

ch_tooth_fairy.text: A tooth wobbles loose. You have heard of a small winged creature that pays for them.

choices.negotiate: Leave a note asking for more

outcomes.coin: Morning brings a shiny coin. The economy of baby teeth is thriving.
outcomes.forgot: The fairy forgot. You are told she had a busy night. You do not forget this.
outcomes.rich: The fairy is impressed by your business sense and pays double.
outcomes.flat: The fairy ignores your note and pays the usual rate.

ch_lemonade_stand.text: It is a hot day and you have a pitcher of lemonade and an entrepreneurial gleam in your eye.

outcomes.sold_out: The whole street buys a cup. You count your coins like a dragon.
outcomes.meh: Three customers, two of them your relatives. You drink the rest.

ch_bike.text: Your parents unscrew the training wheels. You are told you are ready. You are not told how.

outcomes.soar: You wobble, you wobble, then you fly. Gravel has never felt so far away.
outcomes.crash: You meet the hedge. Your knee is now a map of the hedge.

ch_early_reader.text: You have figured out that the squiggles on cereal boxes mean things. Now nothing is safe from you.

choices.devour: Read every label in the house

ch_music_lessons.text: A relative's old instrument lands in your lap. Somebody mentions lessons, in a hopeful voice.

ch_first_day_school.text: First day of school. Your backpack is bigger than your torso and everyone looks equally terrified.

outcomes.great: Within an hour you have a best friend and a missing sandwich.
outcomes.shaky: You hold the doorframe for ten minutes. The teacher is kind about it.

ch_show_and_tell.text: It is show-and-tell day. You can bring anything, as long as it is not alive. Some rules are more flexible than others.

outcomes.legend: The class gasps. You are briefly the most interesting person in the building.
outcomes.caught: Your teacher raises one eyebrow. The story falls apart mid-sentence.

ch_library_card.text: The school librarian notices you reading above your grade. She hands you a card and a very long look.

ch_bully.text: A larger kid has decided your lunch money is his lunch money. He has a smile like a closed door.

outcomes.wins: He blinks, mutters, and walks off. You stand there, shaking, a legend.
outcomes.loses: It does not go well. Your pride hurts longer than your nose.

ch_bully_followup.text: The kid from last month is back at it, but this time he has an audience.

choices.joke: Make a joke at his expense

outcomes.laugh: The audience laughs with you, not at you. He goes red and leaves.
outcomes.worse: The joke lands on the floor. His response lands on you.

ch_class_test.text: A pop quiz drops onto your desk. The teacher says it will not count, in the tone of someone who is lying.

outcomes.pass: Logic, it turns out, works some of the time. You scrape a solid grade.
outcomes.fail: Logic did not show up. A red number appears in the corner.

ch_school_play.text: The class is doing a play about a very important tree. Auditions are open and nobody wants to be the tree.

outcomes.lead: You get the lead. Your mom cries during the bow.
outcomes.tree: You become the tree. You stand very still and give it everything.

ch_science_fair.text: The science fair is in two weeks and your volcano is, in your opinion, mostly done.

outcomes.prize: It erupts exactly on time. A blue ribbon is pinned to your chest.
outcomes.mess: It erupts early, on a judge. You are asked to step away from the table.

ch_recital.text: Your music teacher announces a recital. It will be in the gym, in front of everyone's grandparents.

outcomes.standing: The gym applauds. A grandparent you have never met weeps.
outcomes.flub: You lose your place twice and recover once. The grandparents clap kindly.

ch_cheating.text: The answer key is sitting on the teacher's desk. The teacher is facing the other way. Time moves slowly.

outcomes.clean: Nobody saw. You feel awful, which is a strange return on investment.
outcomes.busted: The teacher turns around at the worst possible second. A letter goes home.

ch_mother_lullaby.text: {{name}} hums the same four notes every night until your eyes close. It is the best music in the world.

ch_father_shoulders.text: {{name}} hoists you onto their shoulders at the parade. From up here you can see everything, including hats.

ch_sibling_blame.text: A lamp lies shattered in the living room. {{name}} points at you. You point at {{name}}. A grown-up is on the way.

outcomes.clear: The grown-ups give up. The lamp becomes a household mystery.
outcomes.caught: Your story has more holes than the lamp. You both get sent to your rooms.

ch_sibling_borrow.text: {{name}} borrowed your favorite toy and returned it with a new, mysterious chew mark.

outcomes.fair: {{name}} hands over a better toy. Justice, of a kind.
outcomes.fight: The negotiation turns into wrestling. Nobody wins, everyone has a rug burn.

ch_friend_secret.text: {{name}} whispers a secret and makes you swear on everything you own. You own a sticker collection and a shoe.

outcomes.safe: That one person tells no one. Miracles do happen.
outcomes.spread: By lunch the whole grade knows. {{name}} stops talking to you.

ch_friend_fight.text: You and {{name}} are in a heated argument about whether a hot dog is a sandwich. It is no longer about the hot dog.

outcomes.respect: {{name}} admits you have a point. Peace returns, damp with pride.
outcomes.frosty: Two weeks of silence follow. The hot dog remains unclassified.

ch_mother_vegetables.text: {{name}} places a plate of broccoli in front of you and says you cannot leave until it is gone. You have all night.

outcomes.stealth: The broccoli vanishes. You will not be told how you did it.
outcomes.spotted: {{name}} finds it in your pocket three days later.

ch_father_fishing.text: {{name}} takes you fishing at dawn. The lake is quiet, the thermos is warm, and nothing is biting.

outcomes.big: A fish bites. It is enormous in your memory and in the photo.
outcomes.nothing: Nothing bites. You split a sandwich and call it a good day.

ch_mother_homework.text: {{name}} offers to help with your homework and then solves the whole page in the wrong order.

ch_road_trip.text: The whole family is stuffed into the car for a trip that is supposedly four hours long. The back seat has no legroom and a lot of opinions.

outcomes.hit: Everyone is playing by mile forty. Four hours becomes three and a half.
outcomes.flop: Nobody understands the rules, including you.

ch_ear_infection.text: You pull at your ear and wail with feeling. It is a classic sign, and a very loud one.

outcomes.ok: It clears by itself. You stay grumpy for another week out of principle.
outcomes.worse: It gets worse. The doctor visit is more fun than the pain was.

ch_chickenpox.text: You wake up covered in itchy red dots. A grown-up mutters a word that sounds like "quarantine".

choices.movie: Lie on the couch all week

ch_peanut_reaction.text: At a birthday party you take a bite of a cookie and your lips swell. The party becomes a hospital visit.

outcomes.fine: It was just the milk. A rare and joyful false alarm.
outcomes.allergy: It was not the milk. Peanuts are now your enemy.

ch_broken_arm.text: You attempt a jump you saw in a cartoon. The cartoon failed to mention the ground.

outcomes.signed: Everyone signs it and you feel like a celebrity for a month.
outcomes.itchy: It itches in places you cannot reach. You use a ruler.

ch_glasses.text: You cannot read the board anymore. The optometrist hands you a pair of frames and says you look "very studious".

outcomes.cool: Your frames are the talk of recess. You are suddenly very interesting.
outcomes.dorky: The frames are loud, round, and impossible to ignore. Nobody says anything. Everyone looks.

ch_found_coin.text: A shiny coin sits on the sidewalk, heads up. Fate has left you a small, round gift.

ch_lost_at_store.text: You turn around and your parent is gone. There is only a wall of cereal and the hum of freezers.

outcomes.found: You are found by the toy aisle, completely at ease.
outcomes.stuck: You end up at the front desk, hearing your own name over the speaker.

ch_thunderstorm.text: A thunderstorm shakes the windows. The lights flicker and the dog starts to growl at nothing.

ch_neighbor_dog.text: The neighbor's dog is bigger than you, and it has just discovered you exist.

outcomes.friend: The dog collapses against your leg and an alliance is formed.
outcomes.nip: The dog nips your sleeve. Nothing worse than a ripped sleeve and a bruised ego.

ch_freak_accident.text: You decide to climb the shelf for a cookie. The shelf has been waiting a long time for this.
